headline: 先拿真实反馈，暂时不要放量。

blockers.title: No measured feedback yet
blockers.detail: The system has not seen real impressions or engagement, so scaling would be blind.
blockers.nextAction: Post at most the seed batch and import metrics before increasing volume.

blockers.title: Not enough fresh publish candidates
blockers.detail: 3 fresh candidates are available for posting today.
blockers.nextAction: Refresh Live Feed and import external candidates from the source supply workbench.

blockers.title: Draft gap is too large for the target
blockers.nextAction: Fill source-pack rows, rerun daily, then rerun draft-plan and content-calendar.

blockers.title: Source supply is below target
blockers.detail: 80 more source candidates are needed for the current account mix.
blockers.nextAction: Fill the 100 source-pack rows that still need real candidates.

blockers.title: Real multi-account X auth is not connected
blockers.detail: Account profiles exist, but OAuth binding is intentionally not the current bottleneck.
blockers.nextAction: Keep auth deferred until feedback and source quality gates are stable.

actionPlan: 先发 1-3 条 seed posts，全部手动确认并记录 accountId。
补来源：优先填 source-pack 里缺口最大的圈子，不要用低质候选硬凑。
刷新 Live Feed，并从 X/newsletter/社区手动导入新鲜候选。
今天最多按 safe gate 发 3 条，不要按 20 账号目标硬放量。
有 measured winners 后，再把强信号工具推进 thread / SEO review / affiliate research。
notes: This is a scale-readiness report, not a permission to auto-post.
Manual confirmation remains required for every X publish action.
If safeNewPosts is lower than targetDailyPosts, keep the batch small and fill feedback first.
